audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Gwen Levels 2-3 while the page's own whys call both of those rows even.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Skill/Skill/Zaahen/Skill/Gwen/Gwen and matches whys[1] and whys[2] exactly.
audit.corrected: Levels 2-3 to Skill, Levels 4-5 to Zaahen; difficulty 6/10 lowered to 5/10 on a 49.79% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike rows say things like 'His walk-down window before your item' and 'Hallowed Mist answers his ult commit' without naming a single ability.
audit.why: His walk-down is Aureate Rush (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) into a Dreaded Return pull (14 down to 12s); the ult he commits is Grim Deliverance (110/95/80s, 600 range).
audit.corrected: Every phase row and spike now names the ability and its cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer states a single Zaahen interaction; the full layer literally tracks 'Zaahen Ultimate'.
audit.why: Riot on Dreaded Return: 'Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him' — it is a line, so the counterplay is standing off the line rather than out of range. Riot on The Darkin Glaive: it 'slashes twice on his next attack, dealing bonus damage and healing himself. Zaahen can recast this ability to have his next attack deal bonus damage and knock up his target' — the knockup is the recast, so the second swing is the dangerous one. Riot on Cultivation of War: 'When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive' — a full-stack Zaahen has a second health bar, so Needlework spent on the first one is wasted. Riot on Grim Deliverance: it heals 'for a portion of the damage dealt', which with The Darkin Glaive's heal is why _missing-interactions.json flags this matchup for Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Line-not-range, the recast knockup, the revive, and the two heal sources all written into both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Confirmed — the page tracked an unnamed 'Ultimate'.
audit.why: The Darkin Glaive 10/9/8/7/6s, Dreaded Return 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, Aureate Rush 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, Grim Deliverance 110/95/80s.
audit.corrected: Dreaded Return is now the tracked cooldown; Aureate Rush's 8-10s gap is the commit window.
